newcode='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    components = []
    singletons = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
            if len(cells) == 1:
                singletons.append(cells[0])
            else:
                ys = [p[0] for p in cells]; xs = [p[1] for p in cells]
                components.append((color, min(ys), max(ys), min(xs), max(xs), cells))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for y, x in singletons:
        candidates = [obj for obj in components if obj[1] <= y <= obj[2] and obj[3] <= x <= obj[4]]
        if candidates:

            out[y][x] = obj[0]
        else:
            # Use the nearest non-singleton component when outside all component bounds.
            obj = min(components, key=lambda o: min(abs(y-a)+abs(x-b) for a,b in o[5]))
            out[y][x] = obj[0]
    return out
'''
